The case: Defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, concealed that fact, and signed a transfer agreement with victim Wei for 550k, got 480k, used to repay personal debt. This is fraud (诈骗) – specifically, fraud by selling property that he does not own (or already sold). Could also be "contract fraud" (合同诈骗) as in examples where fraudulent contract for sale. In Chinese criminal law, "诈骗罪" (fraud) includes contract fraud. The examples: many similar cases labeled "诈骗" or "合同诈骗". For example, earlier example: "张1某...签订发包合同...诈骗" labeled "合同诈骗". So answer likely "合同诈骗". Also maybe "非法占有" but that's part of fraud. So single crime: 合同诈骗.
